sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points, travel to face Alsager Town on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. Despite a recent loss, Sandbach remain 1st with a strong record of 7 wins, 1 draw and 2 losses from 10 games. Alsager sit bottom of the division with just 4 points from 10 matches and have lost their last four games, making this a fixture where the league leaders will be heavily favored.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town host Dawley Town in a direct battle between two of the division's stronger sides—Stafford have 20 points to Dawley's 11. AFC Bridgnorth (3rd, 19 points) travel to face Eccleshall (5th, 18 points), another fixture with title-race implications. Wolverhampton Casuals, also on 19 points, host Wednesfield Community in a battle further down the standings. Bilston Town (6th, 17 points) visit Foley Meir (14th, 11 points), while Barnton (7th, 15 points) host Shawbury United, who are in dire form with six consecutive losses. New Mills, on 14 points, travel to Market Drayton Town, who have just 12 points and have mixed recent results. In the basement, Cheadle Heath Nomads (17th, 7 points) face Telford Town (18th, 6 points) in a fixture between two struggling sides, while Brereton Social (14th, 11 points) host Widnes Town, who sit rock-bottom with just 2 points from 7 games. Crewe host Allscott Heath in a mid-table clash. A midweek fixture on Wednesday 7 October sees Brereton Social host Wednesfield Community.
